# Benoit Ardiet

> Senior software engineer, fintech payments, in Quito, Ecuador (UTC-5, US Eastern hours). Runs a Swiss money-transfer platform end to end: .NET APIs and about forty payment-partner integrations, a SQL Server database of 1,900 stored procedures, a React Native app in both stores, Jenkins CI/CD, Azure, Cloudflare. Works with coding agents daily since 2024. English, French and Spanish.

Verified results: production deadlocks from 288 a month to about 4 (Extended Events captures), P95 latency from 1.56 s to 512 ms over 22.3M requests (telemetry), Azure spend cut 59% (Microsoft invoices), one reporting page from 66 s to about 1 s (commit history).

Contact: benoitardiet@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/benoit-ardiet/
GitHub: https://github.com/VirtuaChamp

- [Cloudflare outage continuity](https://benoitardiet.com/work/cloudflare-outage-continuity): restoring service in under half an hour during the 18 November 2025 Cloudflare outage
